launch_authorization: Implemented and unit-tested (torch-free part) only; nothing prepared, fitted or evaluated by the author. Requires the user's decision, the D0 preparation below and a passed --preflight-only.
design_source: GPT handoff 2026-10-26 section 7 (multi-year protocol, controller, fixed baselines, one information group per comparison, all+normal reporting); user decisions 2026-10-25 (add years; normal-operation training and primary evaluation)
scope: first multi-year numeric base benchmark; no Wiki; no novelty claim
questions: Q1 information: does the end-of-hour state (power_last10, wind_last10) improve the same architecture?
Q2 capacity: with four training years, does a small nonlinear mixer beat a flattened linear map on the same inputs?
Q3 training cohort: does training DLinear on normal-operation windows instead of all windows help, on each test cohort?
Q4 naive: does the validation-chosen trained configuration beat the last-10-minute Persistence?
novelty_claim: none; DLinear, a flattened linear map and TSMixer-basic are published baselines

data.source: Zenodo 16807551, Kelmarsh six Senvion MM92, CC BY 4.0

development_preparation.use: identity reference only: every 2016-2019 row of the v28 preparation must equal this registered CSV

v28_preparation.rule: prepared only after this protocol is frozen; 2022-2024 are never prepared or read in v28

data.common_window_rule: ONE series is built with the union of all channels; every arm uses exactly these windows (finite history in all nine channels, finite four power targets); smaller-input arms only drop channels
data.scaler: provider rule: mean/std of all training-year rows (ddof 0, NaN ignored); not refitted per cohort

cohorts.normal: all four target hours are normal-operation hours (ex-post, uses the target period's operating state; conditional accuracy only)
cohorts.all: every common window with original labels (deployment accuracy)
cohorts.training_cohort_policy: every arm trains on normal windows of the train years and selects its epoch on normal windows of the validation year, except the declared control DLinear_alltrain which trains and selects on all windows
cohorts.reporting: every metric table reports BOTH test cohorts; normal is primary by user decision, all is mandatory secondary; cohort sizes and normal share are reported

training.selection_metric: validation original-scale MAE on the same normal cohort for every arm, including DLinear_alltrain
training.tie_policy: strictly lower MAE updates; ties keep the earlier epoch

stages.name: data identity
stages.checks: v28 preparation metadata (schema 2, years, curve years, CSV hash); every 2016-2019 row equal to the registered development CSV; identical power curves; common-window counts

stages.name: selection freeze
stages.freeze: every selected state hash and validation metrics, plus the validation-chosen configuration for Q4 and for any next round, written before any test window is instantiated

stages.name: single test evaluation of every arm on both cohorts

validation_choice: among LinearFlat_base, LinearFlat_last10, TSMixer_base, TSMixer_last10: lowest seed-mean validation normal MAE (ties: fewer parameters)

statistics.cohort: computed separately on test normal and test all
statistics.seed_handling: losses averaged over the 3 seeds on identical windows
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm over the C1-C5 MAE Newey-West p-values within each cohort; raw p retained
statistics.rmse: issue-time block bootstrap of squared-error sums; separate from the MAE CI

rules.information_supported: C1 or C2 on test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0, Holm p <= 0.05 and RMSE gain > 0, AND the same comparison on test all has MAE gain >= 0; supports the wider input variant, not pure information attribution at equal parameter count
rules.capacity_supported: C3 on test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0, Holm p <= 0.05 and RMSE gain > 0, AND on test all MAE gain >= 0
rules.training_cleaning_supported: C4 on test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0 and Holm p <= 0.05, AND on test all MAE gain >= 0; both arms select epochs on the same normal validation cohort
rules.beats_naive: C5 on test normal AND test all: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0 and Holm p <= 0.05
rules.attribution_limits: C1/C2 change input width and parameter count. C3 changes architecture, parameter count and optimization geometry, not capacity alone. No Wiki contribution or causal attribution is established by these contrasts.
rules.next_round: the next protocol starts from the validation-chosen configuration, adds at most one further information group, and confirms on 2022 prepared under its own frozen protocol; 2021 is not reused as a confirmation year; 2023-2024 stay sealed
rules.no_post_hoc: no arm, seed, epoch, threshold, cohort rule or channel may be chosen from test results

forbidden: test access before the S1 freeze
modifying v25-v27 or the registered development preparation
